title: Sanasaa
tagline: Retail storefront app for browsing and ordering products, backed by a Laravel inventory system.
overview: Sanasaa is a retail app built to give a local store a digital storefront, with a Flutter client for browsing products and a Laravel backend managing inventory and orders.
problem: The store had no online presence and relied entirely on in-person or word-of-mouth sales, limiting reach and making inventory tracking manual.
solution: A Flutter storefront app for browsing categorized products with a Laravel API handling inventory, pricing, and order records.
architecture: Flutter app consuming a Laravel REST API, with product and category data modeled for straightforward inventory management by non-technical staff.
features: Basic order history for repeat customers
challenges: Designing an inventory data model simple enough for non-technical staff to manage through the admin side
Handling product images efficiently on limited mobile data connections
lessonsLearned: For small retail clients, simplicity in the admin experience matters more than feature completeness
futureImprovements: Barcode scanning for faster inventory updates
Simple sales reporting for the store owner
results: Gave a local retail business its first digital ordering channel
